claims.finding: Finite pumping lengths/exponents neither prove the universal pumping counterargument nor refute it from a surviving sampled partition.
claims.fix: Keep trust well_formed, preserve per-p partition/exponent diagnostics and known membership witnesses; refute only invalid length or confirmed chosen-word nonmembership.
regressions: singleton {a^10} closes every sampled partition but is regular
cofinite unary language excluding length 4: a sampled partition survives i=0,2 but escapes at i=3
unknown witness/pumped membership is never false

claims.finding: Depth-bounded Nerode-index stabilization/growth cannot decide regularity; arbitrary accepted words do not refute a non-regularity claim.
claims.fix: Closure estimation returns scoped plausible diagnostics with well_formed trust; legacy verified/disproved empirical statuses also remain well_formed.

claims.finding: Backreferences and nested productions alone imply no language verdict.
claims.fix: Unknown syntax hints dispatch both constructive and destructive specialists; retain exact right/left-linear sufficient criteria.
counterexamples: S -> aSb | aS | Sb | epsilon generates a*b*

claims.finding: Existential even-palindromic prefix/suffix cannot be reduced to equal adjacent edge symbols; an internal reversal pair is not an edge pattern.
claims.fix: Downgrade unbounded reversal syntax to unknown; recognize an edge pair by actual position.
counterexamples: abba = ab rev(ab) has an even palindromic edge without an equal-symbol edge
baaab has an internal aa but no nonempty even palindromic edge

claims.finding: A CFL bounded pumping window need not lie in a prefix; enumeration does not prove an infinite intersection formula.
claims.fix: Replace grammar worked proofs with production induction #a <= 3#b+2, recursive derivation of every a^(3n+2)b^n, and universal REG xyz pumping/Nerode proofs directly for L.
claims.proof_check: S -> SaSb: deviations add then subtract 2, so two bounds <=2 yield <=2; A -> bSb subtracts 6; aa/epsilon/bb are bases. Set left S -> aa and recurse right S to add three a and one b each step. REG |xy|<=p puts y inside the a-prefix; pumping i=2 violates the global bound.

claims.finding: Unknown membership cannot refute Nerode/free-text claims; Nerode family words need not belong to L, and an empty suffix is allowed.
claims.fix: Preserve unknown oracle results, permit empty/literal suffixes, label Nerode bounded_pass with explicit checked-pair scope only, and correct proof-checker instructions.

claims.finding: A non-regular subset does not imply a non-regular containing language.
claims.fix: Require exact closure reductions or a direct universal argument; add core REG sources to seven active classification/proof prompts.
